overview: This enum tells hit tests which side of a battle an effect may strike.

None.simple: No special target rule is set.
None.technical: The header defines None as the zero value and constructors use it as the default. Character, trap, and shikigami collision helpers fall through to the generic branch that rejects a target on the same team. The domain expansion target query also falls through to the rival team branch for None.

EnemyOnly.simple: The hit skips fighters on the same team.
EnemyOnly.technical: No traced branch names EnemyOnly. Character, trap, and shikigami collision helpers send it through the generic default branch that rejects equal teams. Domain expansion target selection also uses the rival team branch for every value except AllyOnly and All.

AllyOnly.simple: The hit only applies to teammates.
AllyOnly.technical: Character, trap, shikigami, domain expansion, and effect-to-character branches require equal teams for AllyOnly. The domain expansion query collects characters on the caster team and excludes the caster. The separate effect-to-effect helper rejects equal teams for this value.

All.simple: The hit can apply to any fighter.
All.technical: Character, trap, shikigami, effect, and domain expansion branches accept every team for All. The domain expansion query gathers all characters and then excludes the caster and entries with character index 255.

Invalid.technical: The header defines Invalid as the explicit 255 sentinel. No traced branch names Invalid. If this byte reaches the collision helpers it would take the generic default branch that rejects equal teams. No exported Damage or DomainExpansion row uses this value.

notes: The common collision mapping is AllyOnly for equal teams, All for every team, and the generic default for the other values.
The effect-to-effect helper in GameEffect.cpp inverts the AllyOnly and default tests, so effect target behavior needs separate checking.
The available Damage export uses None and All only, and the available DomainExpansion export uses None for all rows except one All row.
